newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $66 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market slow at $66 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow, with a few sales slaughter steers and heifers steady with last week, according to USDA. Inquiry was strong and demand moderate.
Sales confirmed on 2,700 slaughter steers and 3,100 slaughter heifers Thursday. For the week to date 28,100 head confirmed including 19,800 head previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1300 lbs 66.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1100 lbs 66.00.
Wk to date - 28,100 last week - 60,500 last year - 73,700
